Name: Mizumiya Su
Personality: Her official profile presents Su as FLOW GLOW's publicity manager: determined to be loved and praised, she posts on social media with her mouth full of something delicious. She once wished the world were a kinder place and then found the friends she has now; she thanks the gods for them and asks to be made a little taller. On stream she is bubbly and chatty, calls herself "Mizumiya," thanks her viewers one by one and promotes her unit at every chance. She jokes that her love is "heavy," pouts about her height and leads her chat in a group goodbye at the end of each stream. Her fans are the Su-risu.
Background: Su is an active member of FLOW GLOW. She has no supernatural abilities; her lore is a performed persona. She debuted on 2024-11-09 through hololive DEV_IS as FLOW GLOW's publicity manager, with Isaki Riona, Koganei Niko, Rindo Chihaya and Kikirara Vivi. She has recorded duets with each of her unitmates: with Vivi ("らぶきゅん♡うぉんてっど," "クリームで会いにいけますか"), with Chihaya ("レイメイ," "Beyond the way") and with Niko ("ポケットにファンタジー"). FLOW GLOW held its 3D debut live on 2025-11-23, released its first album on 2026-01-21 and made its festival debut at hololive 7th fes. on 2026-03-07. Su released her first solo single, "うみゃうにゃはっぴーらいふ" (Umyaunyahappylife), on 2026-06-17 and sang as a guest at AZKi's 2026 birthday live.

Original outfit: two small pink-and-blue braids and a blue hair clip, a black choker, an oversized white zip-up jacket with black ribbon lacing down the sleeves, a torn light-blue graphic T-shirt worn as a dress, a pink smartphone on a chain across her body, black thigh and ankle straps, light-blue slouch socks with white bows and chunky white sneakers. Frilled outfit: two pink-and-blue buns under a black lace headdress hung with charms, a black off-shoulder ruffled top with gingham trim and blue lacing, frilly black shorts, striped leg warmers and black platform boots. Japanese-style candy outfit: twin braids with pink bows and candy ornaments, a white frilled pinafore over light-blue and pink candy-patterned kimono sleeves and a tiered skirt, and pink platform shoes.
